entityDescription:
Company Overview - GEMINI Space Solutions & Consulting (SSC)
GEMINI Space Solutions & Consulting (SSC) is a Netherlands-based SME operating at the forefront of Earth Observation (EO) innovation, data fusion, and applied artificial intelligence. Backed by a trusted international network of research and industry partners, GEMINI SSC delivers tailored EO-based services and consulting across Europe and beyond - empowering public authorities, research institutions, and commercial actors with insights that drive sustainability, resilience, and innovation.
As a long-standing contributor to ESA’s EO ecosystem, GEMINI SSC specialises in multi-source satellite data processing - integrating Copernicus Sentinel missions, Contributing Missions (CCM), and very high-resolution datasets with in-situ and municipal data streams. Its work focuses particularly on urban environments, smart-city services, and climate adaptation, aligning with ESA’s Φ-lab and InCubed priorities and supporting digital-green transitions across Europe.
Core Business Lines: Urban Analytics & EO Services: EO-based monitoring and analytics across climate adaptation, mobility, pollution, green infrastructure, and energy transition - with AI-enhanced tools for municipalities and agencies. AI and Data Fusion Models: Integration of satellite data with mobility, IoT, and socio-economic indicators to deliver fine-grained, predictive insights tailored to user needs. End-to-End Project Deployment: From concept design to system prototyping, including field validation and co-development with local users. Capacity Building & Policy Support: Technical training and institutional capacity development to support uptake of EO and AI by cities, ministries, and research organisations. Geospatial Data Provisioning: On-demand delivery of fused EO datasets for calibration, validation, and operational use - including pre-processed ML-ready indices (NDVI, NO2, change detection, impervious surfaces, etc.).
Vision and Mission: GEMINI SSC’s vision is to harness the power of satellite data, artificial intelligence, and cloud infrastructure to support next-generation urban resilience and planetary sustainability. We aim to make geospatial intelligence more accessible, interpretable, and actionable - serving as a catalyst for evidence-based decision making across sectors.
Forward Capabilities and Strategic Outlook: With deep domain expertise and cross-sector engagement, GEMINI SSC is positioned to incubate and scale innovative solutions such as Space-enabled Urban Digital Twins for predictive planning and climate adaptation, powered by AI-ready Copernicus pipelines; Edge-AI EO CubeSat Prototypes enabling on-board analytics for fast-response monitoring of urban heat, emissions, land change, and mobility; Impact Dashboards for Municipalities translating EO/AI outputs into operational tools for decision-makers; Smart Resilience Indices to support EU Green Deal, Climate Law, and SDG tracking across urban contexts; Capacity building and co-design pilots with cities in the Netherlands, Germany, France and other ESA Member States, particularly in synergy with Φ-lab, InCubed and Destination Earth frameworks; Bridging Science, Innovation, and Policy by translating cutting-edge Earth Observation research into actionable frameworks for EU missions, national space strategies, and smart-city programmes - with active engagement in Φ-lab initiatives, InCubed, Horizon Europe, and key fora such as EC, EARSC, NEREUS, IAC, and UN-led platforms.
GEMINI SSC is well positioned to support ESA EO programmes - from InCubed and DestinE to Φ-sat and AI-enhanced CubeSat demonstrators - with an emphasis on scalability, cross-sector engagement, and transformational impact.

entityDescription:
Astranova Partners is a strategic consulting firm specializing in accelerating the growth of fintech companies, payment platforms, brokers, and wealthtech organizations across Europe and LATAM. With over 15 years of experience, Astranova combines proven methodologies—such as its proprietary S.C.A.L.E. framework—with hands-on execution, strategy, and advanced technology to deliver sustainable commercial growth.
The team focuses on designing and implementing expansion strategies, optimizing revenue, and supporting international go-to-market efforts. Astranova Partners works closely with clients as genuine strategic allies, integrating with their teams to drive impact, generate real value, and establish lasting relationships.
Astranova leads and manages several projects across the fintech and digital sectors. One of these projects is Sentinel Crop (sentinelcrop.com), for which the company is currently applying to a development program.

Sentinel Crop is transforming agricultural insurance through innovative technology. The platform combines real-time satellite monitoring, blockchain, and AI-powered risk assessment to deliver accurate, transparent, and fully automated crop insurance solutions.
Using Copernicus Sentinel satellite data, Sentinel Crop continuously tracks crop health, employing NDVI analysis and advanced vegetation indices. Its machine learning models analyze weather patterns, soil conditions, and historical records to predict crop risks with up to 95% accuracy. Blockchain technology, specifically Ethereum-based smart contracts, ensures that all insurance policies and claims are processed automatically, transparently, and immutably.
Farmers easily register their parcels, access real-time monitoring, and purchase customized parametric insurance policies—receiving instant, paperwork-free payouts when pre-set conditions are met. For insurance companies, Sentinel Crop delivers robust AI-driven risk data, enables creation of objective policies, and streamlines portfolio management with live analytics and automated claims processing.
Sentinel Crop stands out for its instant payouts, high accuracy, transparency, and always up-to-date satellite insights—making it a next-generation solution for both agricultural producers and insurers.

This allows more agile orbital manoeuvres, cost-effective logistics, and dual-use applications acrossLEO, GEO, cislunar and interplanetary domains.
In parallel, NSS is developing HTS-based power management and distribution solutions, including superconducting harnesses, delivering near-lossless power transfer and improved thermal stability. - SUPREME (EIC Transition project):Critical Design Review completed, progressing to TRL 5–6 by 2026 with full prototype testing.

AeroBeam is developing the world’s first drone-delivered, machine learning-guided laser cleaning and surface analysis system. Our system combines advanced imaging, precision laser ablation, and autonomous drones to identify and remove contaminants safely and efficiently. At AeroBeam, we are developing drone-mounted LIBS and laser ablation systems for terrestrial applications, such as the decontamination and inspection of wind turbines. We have proven the efficacy for LIBS-based machine learning and effective, precise ablation of wind turbine contamination. Classification between turbine and contamination was approximately 100% accurate and processed in less than half a second. Wind turbines can lose up to 40% of their power output due to contamination on blade surfaces, and AeroBeam aims to address this issue, allowing our customers to reach their full revenue generating potential .

By merging drones and laser technologies into a novel platform, we are creating systems that we believe could be adapted for future use in space missions. The integration of drone-based laser deployment for ablation and spectroscopy represents a promising direction for next-generation planetary exploration and in-situ resource analysis. Also, as the space launch market expands, rapid drone-based inspection analysis and maintenance for reusable rockets between launches is envisaged as a further application.

Our initial product is a ground-based machine vision contamination detection system to be sold in 2026, followed by the full drone system in 2027–2028. Revenue will come from product sales, pilot programs, and service contracts. We’ve received positive strong early feedback, including a pilot project expression of interest from ESB, Wind energy Ireland and a letter of interest from Irish space company MBRYONICS.

The founding team includes domain experts in LIBS, precision optics, AI, and drone engineering. AeroBeam offers a scalable, space-ready technology with immediate terrestrial and long-term non terrestrial application.
